newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 15.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on May 15:
WASHINGTON - Producer prices fell 0.6 percent in April despite robust economic growth and the lowest jobless rate in 25 years.
WASHINGTON - Coffee futures prices hit their highest level since 1994, when a frost in Brazil iced coffee production and sent prices soaring.
WASHINGTON - Summer is near, and the area tourism industry's fortunes are expected to brighten with a strong boost from leisure travellers, according to an industry survey.
WASHINGTON - A furniture retailer who was shut down in Virginia for violating consumer affairs laws and reopened in Maryland was fined this week for similar practices.
WASHINGTON - The House Judiciary Committee approved by voice vote a bill that would loosen the government's control of encryption technology.
